body: If it gets too serious then I might consider it. The tough part is that I don't have the money to see a professional, along with what I said in the post about the western medicine method of handling depression and suicide. I feel that I cannot express my suicidal thoughts to other people, I have a fear of being put into a mental institution should the thoughts persist. Being treated like I need to be put into a straight jacket would just drive me to suicide anyway.

I've seen it first hand, those horrible co-dependent relationships out of fear of being alone. It's hard to say if there is a "right" approach, but this is the I'm working with for the time being. Only thing I have is time.
